topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just can't believe this. My flight has been delayed again, and there's no end in sight. They're giving me the runaround, and all I can think about is how I'm going to miss this—this crucial moment that I've been preparing for, working for, for months. Every minute that ticks by is just another excuse they're going to throw my way. I’m stuck here, surrounded by the same recycled air and the constant murmur of indifferent announcements. I have a right to be somewhere, and they’re the ones standing in my way. This isn’t just inconvenient; it’s a complete disaster.
